  <div class="page-header-inner">
    <h1>Types Of Financial Aid</h1>
  </div>
</div>    <div class="wp-block-group alignwide is-style-general-subpage-group"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p>There are a variety of financial aid options to make Spring Hill College affordable for you and your family as you pursue your education. Nearly 100% of our students receive financial assistance. </p>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-9d6595d7 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:15%"><div class="wp-block-image">
<figure class="aligncenter size-large is-resized"><img decoding="async" width="55" height="55" src="https://www.shc.edu/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/calculator.png" alt="Calculator icon" class="wp-image-991" style="width:79px;height:79px"/></figure>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66.66%">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Net Price Calculator</h3>



<p>Our <a href="https://www.shc.edu/admissions-aid/tuition-financial-aid/net-price-calculator/">Net Price Calculator</a> is a convenient tool designed to provide students and their parents with an estimated offer package based on your specific situation and information.</p>
</div>
</div>



<p>Student financial aid offers at Spring Hill may include one or more of the following:</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Scholarships </h2>



<p>Spring Hill College offers academic merit scholarships to both first-year and transfer students. These merit scholarships are based on a holistic review of a student’s application file. Consideration is given to one’s GPA, high school rigor, test scores (if submitted) and involvement. Each student’s file will be reviewed and no special application is required. These scholarships are available to every student who qualifies for them regardless of financial need. We also offer athletics scholarships and other special scholarships.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Federal Grants</h2>



<p>Federal grants do not have to be repaid.  One must demonstrate financial need to receive a federal grant. Grant eligibility is determined by information provided by your <a href="http://fafsa.gov/">Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)</a> and can be funded by federal and state governments, as well as Spring Hill College. <a href="https://www.shc.edu/admissions-aid/tuition-financial-aid/types-of-financial-aid/grants/">Learn more</a>.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Loans</h2>



<p>Federal student loans are the most affordable loans available to students with the lowest interest rates and deferred payments until after graduation. Many of these loans are determined by the <a href="http://fafsa.gov/">Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)</a> Click here to <a href="https://www.shc.edu/admissions-aid/tuition-financial-aid/types-of-financial-aid/loans/">learn more</a>.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Student Employment</h2>



<p>Spring Hill College offers student employment through federal work-study, which is a federal program available to qualified students who demonstrate financial need. Preference is given to students with the greatest demonstrated need. Students are employed on campus in positions such as classroom assistants, laboratory assistants, recreation assistants, library assistants and work-study in campus offices with the typical student working approximately 6 hours per week.</p>
